subject.title: fix(pdf): reject unsafe page numbers before analysis

question: Should PDF page selections containing digit-only values beyond JavaScript's safe integer range fail closed instead of silently ignoring or rounding those tokens?
rationale: The patch fixes an imprecise numeric boundary, but it intentionally turns previously tolerated mixed input into an error, so maintainers should explicitly own that compatibility choice.

options.title: Accept fail-closed validation
options.body: Treat unsafe numeric tokens as invalid input and merge after real-tool proof confirms the failure occurs before loading or analysis.

options.title: Preserve tolerant clamping
options.body: Keep ignoring out-of-bounds digit tokens and require a different implementation that avoids unsafe numeric conversion without rejecting the request.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed validation
recommendation.body: Treat unsafe numeric tokens as invalid input and merge after real-tool proof confirms the failure occurs before loading or analysis.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent PDF tool history and the merger of the adjacent fractional-page validation change make him the strongest available owner for this compatibility decision.
